picks.title: Bring Your Holiday Campaigns to Life with Google AI | Creative Drop #2
picks.rationale: First-party release of new ad-creative tools (campaign localization, festive product shots in Asset Studio, photo-to-YouTube video ads) that advertisers can use for holiday campaigns right away.
picks.excerpt: Google Ads' Creative Drop #2 adds AI tools to localize campaigns, generate festive product shots in Asset Studio and turn photos into YouTube video ads for the holiday season.

picks.title: Just Eat Takeaway.com launches JETads, a new AI-first advertising platform for European advertisers
picks.rationale: A new AI-first retail media network goes live in 14 markets, running on JET's personalisation models and offering closed-loop measurement, so it is new ad inventory for FMCG and non-endemic brands.
picks.excerpt: JET launched JETads, an AI-first retail media platform live in 14 markets, using its personalisation models across 59M consumers and 592M yearly orders, with closed-loop measurement for restaurants, FMCG and non-endemic brands.

picks.title: 카카오 "내달 광고 AI 에이전트 'AI 크루' 베타 시작"
picks.rationale: Kakao set a December beta for 'AI Crew', an ad agent that runs campaigns and analyses results from a stated goal. It is a concrete new ad-buying tool on a major Korean platform.
picks.excerpt: 카카오가 3분기 실적 발표에서 목표만 입력하면 광고 집행과 성과 분석을 돕는 광고 AI 에이전트 'AI 크루'를 12월 베타로 시작한다고 밝혔다. 내년 1분기까지 AI 광고 추천용 공통 메모리 인프라도 구축한다.

picks.title: Swivel Wants To Create Agentic Infrastructure For CTV
picks.rationale: New publisher-side infrastructure that lets AI agents buy CTV and streaming ads, automating manual direct-deal work. It is the sell side of agentic media buying.
picks.excerpt: Publisher-tech startup Swivel, founded by ex-FreeWheel and SpringServe executives, is building infrastructure so AI agents can buy TV and streaming ads, automating manual direct-deal tasks in CTV.

picks.title: Visa launches benchmark for AI shopping agents
picks.rationale: Visa released an Agentic Commerce Benchmark. Leading models passed only 57.2% of shopping tests, and 54% of the failed runs still ended in a purchase, which is hard evidence for merchants preparing for agent checkout.
picks.excerpt: Visa's new Agentic Commerce Benchmark found leading AI models passed 57.2% of realistic shopping tests, and 54% of failed runs still ended in a purchase.
